BiblicalUsage: Macharesheth is the hoe, named once, in the same list of farm tools the Israelites carried down to the Philistines for sharpening in 1 Samuel 13:20.
TheologicalSignificance: I take it as a small, honest detail: the Bible names ordinary tools, because ordinary work mattered to the people God was shaping.
